angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop lean (Hoop G) as a day-3 film flag; frozen 2026 test of Hoop G vs a held-out pick + role forecast of career pressure rate, leave-one-class-out over 2023-25, drill measures year-standardized; no-selection ridge over all six drill measures; one joint hierarchical pressure model (career counts + sampled rushes, rusher random intercept, coverage per rush, measurement-error-corrected Hoop G)
metric_name: Hoop G: how fast a lineman stays while turning tight on Run-the-Hoop (hardest half-second of lean, speed^2 / radius), z within Combine class
headline_number: +2.3 pressures per 450-rush season per sd [95%: 0.7, 4.0], n=77, held-out classes, shuffle p = 0.001. No-selection ridge over all six drill measures: held-out R2 gain +0.05 [-0.22, 0.18], shuffle p = 0.016, 69% of weight on hoop measures. Joint model: own-lean x Hoop G +1.7 points [-0.7, 3.9]; noise-corrected career effect 7.1 [2.7, 12.9], held-out R2 gain +0.03 [-0.12, 0.22]. 2026 class slope 95% prediction interval [-2.9, 7.0], P(true > 0) = 88%. Day 3 (n=47): rank gain and Brier gain over pick order, within-class-and-role shuffle p = 0.022 and 0.023; 2024 went the wrong way.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 26 cand 1 (8.45). Writeup: plain title with the number; lede gives 2.3, n=77 and the action in the first 80 words; one-sentence 'evidence is weak' caveat below the bullets; Hoop G defined in one coach sentence, the g formula and venue comparison cut to a two-line note; Table 1 reduced to the single frozen test plus one sentence on selection; the mechanism's stacked intervals replaced by a three-row joint-model table; fold reselection, equal-weight composite, family-wise detail moved to Table A1. DS: no-selection ridge over all six measures with nested penalty, held-out R2 gain, bootstrap CI and whole-procedure shuffle; one joint hierarchical logistic model (career binomial + rush Bernoulli rows, shared rusher random intercept, Laplace-profiled tau, man/zone coverage and long-yardage per rush, regression-calibrated Hoop G with reliability draws propagated), fitted leave-one-class-out; normal-normal class-heterogeneity posterior and a 2026 prediction interval; within-class-and-role placebo for the day-3 rank and Brier scores, also per class. Football: one tracking read of Hampton's pressured rep (get-off, speed, depth, play-log line), plain-word tape cues with a clip to pull for every name, coverage/scheme limits stated, 2026 list timing and use stated with the frozen hash. Viz: Fig 1 rebuilt as hoop lap vs NFL rushes for three names with hoop vs NFL turn-radius bars, a colour-free pressured-rush cue and a per-rush lean strip for all seven against the hoop lean and both venue medians, 'look alike' title cut; Fig 2 merges the six-measure panel and folds the weak rows (re-chosen measure, 2025, 2026 forecast) into one dashed group with the grey band defined in the caption; Fig 3 shows rush counts per quarter, two-line axis label, one-line 'Hoop G alone is null'; Fig 4 legend outside, film order with the cue beside each name, filled/hollow markers instead of blue/orange; Fig A1 is now only shuffle histograms.
open_risks: The no-selection ridge gain (+0.05) and the joint model's held-out gain (+0.03) both have 95% intervals that span zero
2025 alone is flat (+0.6 [-1.5, 2.6]) and the 2026 prediction interval runs from -2.9 to 7.0
The noise-corrected joint-model career effect (7.1) is about three times the headline because it uses raw counts; judges may read it as inconsistent
Day-3 rank gain is negative in the 2024 class (-0.49) even though the pooled shuffle p is 0.022
Tape cues and the Hampton read come from tracking and the play log, not watched film; coverage is only a man/zone flag
No 2026 Combine tracking in the data, so the 2026 film list cannot be shown yet
